trial_gate.scope: Bounded primary-study cache covering established treatments, previous shortlist ingredients, and additional interventional or symptomatic trials. Ingredients without verified administration have unknown testing status. Coverage is not a census of ALS research.

formulation_checks.reason: The ALS pilot did not establish administration of zinc chloride, zinc acetate or elemental zinc metal.

policy.entry_rule: At least one observed supporting graph witness for disease, target or pathway relevance. Association alone never proves benefit.
policy.hard_rule: Carry forward the published first-pass eligibility screen. At targeted review veto a documented contraindication whose prerequisites the chart meets, a label-directed avoid/contraindicated combination with an actual medication, a named strong/moderate CYP1A2 inhibitor under the prior riluzole screen, or a labeled serious respiratory-depression risk explicitly applicable to underlying respiratory impairment. Require a matching chart fact and a primary source. Do not infer contraindications from class similarity, an interaction edge, or missing labs.
policy.soft_rule: Subtract one fixed penalty for a sourced clinically consequential caution applicable to the chart that falls below the veto threshold. Do not stack penalties for multiple warnings. Negative efficacy evidence is reported independently.

review.name: Arimoclomol
review.warning: Decreased weight and diarrhea occurred in the labeled NPC setting with miglustat. Further loss matters after Alex fell from 86 to 77.5 kg; incidence in ALS or local delivery is unknown.
review.medication_check: The label reports no CYP1A2 inhibition or induction in vitro and flags OCT2 substrates. ORARIALS-01 stratified on stable riluzole use. Neither source establishes the safety of the proposed route.

review.contrary: ORARIALS-01 found no improvement in combined function and survival; gastrointestinal events and discontinuations were more frequent with arimoclomol.
review.change: A controlled functional benefit with a credible exposure rationale and tolerability despite weight loss would materially change this assessment.
